translations.web: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”
translations.bsb: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to Him, “They have no more wine.”
translations.kjv: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
translations.asv: And when the wine failed, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
